content: Jesús-e-urbamar, Jesús-benmalad
We-degigusad-sorba, Jesús Galilea-yalaganba bipirmakdii gusad. Ar ade, yapa Judeaʼgi gudigued, ar Judíoʼmar e-oburgwebimalad.
Deun, Judíoʼmar-Neg-Matargana-Iba-onoged bato mosadgined.
E-urbamar Jesúsʼga sokalid: —Wegi be noe, Judeaʼse be nae. Adi, be-sapingan be-ibmar-imaked dakoed.
Ar dule-wargwen mag-e-dakbi abegele, geg odukuar ibmar imaked. Ar be ibmar-dakledisulid-imakdiid, bela dulemar-wagab be imakdo.
E-urbamar weyob Jesúsʼga sogsamardo, ar ade, e-urbamarse-bakar, Jesús-benmalad, we Mesíasʼye.
Jesús e-urbamarga sogdesun: —An Jerusalénʼse-naed-ibagan angardi amba yoo moed. Ar bemargardi ibagan bato gusgu guagwar naidaed.
Ar we-napneg-naidgi-dulemar-bukwad geg isdar bemar-daked. Ar andi isdar an-dakmardo, ar ade, an ega sogdiid, bemar-ibmar-imakdimaladi isganaye.
Bemardi, ibase be namala. Ar angardi, amba an-ibagan yoo mosoggu, andi naosurgweled.
Deyob Jesúsʼdi, e-urbamarga sogsagu, Galileaʼgi bessunnad.
Jesús, Neg-Matargana-Sobaled-E-Ibagi gudigusad
Jesús, e-urbamar-ibase-naded-sorba, ibase nade gusmogad. Jesús emar-wagab nadsulid. Arbakee nadegusad.
Judíoʼmar ibagi Jesús-amidii guarmalad, sokarmalad: “¿Wede bia dule nade?”
Agine dulemar-bukidarad-abargi Jesúsʼgi uurmakarmalad, gwenna-gwenna sokarmalad: “We-Jesús, dule-nuedid.” Baigandi sogmarmogad: “Suli, we, dule-yardakdiidi.”
Ar dulemar Judíoʼmar-dummagan-dobedba, bakar-buud Jesúsʼgi gwen sunmaksasurmalad.
Ar Neg-Matargana-Sobarmalad-E-Iba-onolenaid negabargusgu, Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nonikid. Agi dulemar-odurdaksii gusad.
Judíoʼmar-dummagan geger Jesús-dakdemalad, sogdemalad: “We-dule dummaganse gwen ibmar durdaksasulid, ar degite, ¿igi nabir ibmar-nue-wisi dulemar-odurdake?”
Jesús amarga sogdesun: —An-ibmar-odurdaked angadsulid, Bab-Dummad-an-barmialid-sogedba an dulemar-odurdaked.
Ar dule Bab-Dummad-sogedba nanabiele, mag dakoed, an-ibmar-odurdakdiid Bab-Dummadgi danidibe, igidibe, an-ibmar-odurdakdiid an na dukin onosdibe.
Ar dule wargwengi e-sogedba ibmar-sogdiile, a-dule na nug-dungued amidii daed. Ar e-barmialid-nug-odummogega gudiirdina, adi, we napiragwaddo, a-dulegine, gakan naisurdo.
”¿Ar Moisés bemarga igar-uksasursi? Degite, bemar a-igargi nanadisurmalad. ¿Ibiga be an-oburgwebimarsunna?”
Dulemar, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Nia begi nai. ¿Ar doamar be-oburgwebie?
Jesús amarga sogded: —Obunnoged-ibagi unnila ibmar-dakledisulid-soggwen an imaksad-ulale, ¿geger be an-dakmarde? Emide, be sogmargu, an dule-isganaye.

Moisés bemarga abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar mesismalad. Degi-inigwele, we-igar Moisésʼgi noarsulid, ar dadgan-akar bato gusgu a-igar danikid. Obunnoged-ibagi mer arbaoye igar-mai-inigwele, degite, bemar Obunnoged-ibagi abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imakbukwad.
”Ar bemar Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba ibmar-imakegala, amba obunnoged-ibagi-bakar, bemar abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imakbukwad. Degite, ¿ibiga bemardi obunnoged-ibagi an dule-nudaked, sae be an-dakmarsunna?
Melle dule-daklegedba be sogo we-dule, dule-nuedye, igi, we-dule, dule-isganaye. Suli. Innikigwadba be sogoed.”
Ar we-Jesús, ¿Cristo-sunnadi?
Jerusalénʼginmalad gwenna-gwenna sokarmalad: “¿Ar dummagan we-dule-oburgwega amidimarsursi?
Emide, be dakena, bela-dulemar-abargi sunmakgwisgu, degite, gwen ega akar sogsurmalad. ¿Ar dummagande nue-magar itononimarsi? We, Cristo-sunnadid, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye sogsad-dule.
”Ar anmar wisid, we bia daniki. Ar Cristoʼdi nonikile, anmar wisguosulid, bia daniki.”

Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dulemar-odurdaksigu, binnasur sunmakde, sogded: —Bemar mag-an-dakmalad, degine, be an-wismarbalid an bialidi. An-itolegedba wargwen an danisulid, ar Bab-Dummad-napiragwadid an-barmialid. A-duledi bemar akudakmalad.
Andi a-dule mag an daked, ar agi an danikid. Ar a an-barmialid.
Agine, dummagan Jesús-gabiguarmalanad, degite, gwen gassurmalad, ar ade, yoo e-burgwed-ibagan omoged.
Dulemar-bukidar Jesúsʼgi bengussurmalad, sokarmalad: “Cristo nonikile, ¿bur bule we-dulebali ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid imako be insae? Gwen deyob imako an insasurdo.”
Fariseoʼmar Jesús-gaega suar-ibmala-barmisad
Fariseoʼmar dulemar-sognanaid itosmalad, Jesús, Mesíasʼye. Degisoggu, Fariseoʼmar, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan Jesús-gaega suar-ibmala barmismalad.
Geb Jesús dulemar-e-itobukwadga sogded: —Napi-ichesaar an bemar-abargi gudiid. Dule-an-barmialidse an naesokalid.
Be an-amimalo-inigwele, gwen be an-amimalosulid. An gudiguoedsega geg be namalad.
Degi Judíoʼmar na ga sokarmarsunnad: “¿Ar wede bia naoe? Anmarde bar amiosurmalad. Griegoʼmar-abargi-Judíoʼmar-aisakis-bukmalad-odurdakega, ¿wede naoe?
¿We ibi obarsunna? We sogsad: ‘Be an-amimalo-inigwele, gwen be an-amimalosurye. An gudiguoedsega, geg be namarye.’ ”
Jesús, burba-dulad dulemarga uked
Napi-iba-dummad-naidgi, Jesús gwisgusgu, binnasur sunmakded, sogded: —Ar dule-wargwen uku-uku itodiile, anse dage. Anse dii gobdage.
Ar dule an-bensulile, Bab-Dummad-gardagi sognaiyobi, e-ulubgi diwar-burba-nikad aryomai guoed.

Jesús diwar-burba-nikadye-sogsagusadi, we Bab-Dummad-Burba dulemar-egi-benguosurmalad-abingaoedgi sunmaksad. Deunni, amba yoo Bab-Dummad-Burba nonikid, ar ade, Jesús-nug amba yoo bela-bela ogannoleged.
Dulemar Jesúsʼgi benmalad
Bukidar-dulemar-abargi gwenna-gwenna weyob-Jesús-ibmar-soged itosmargu, sokarmalad: “Ar we-dule, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-napiragwadid.”
Baigandi sogmalad: “We, Cristo-sunnadid.” Degine, baiganmo sogmarmogad: “¿Ar Cristoʼde, Galileaʼgi danikosi? Suli, agi danikosulid.
¿Ar Bab-Dummad-gardagi sognaisursi? Cristo Davidʼgi danikoye. Belén-neggweburgi, David-epenne-gwalulesadgi danikoye.”
Ar Jesús-ulale dulemar na egi bachikgudmalad.
Gwenna-gwenna Jesús-gabiguarmalan-inigwele, gwen gassurgusmalad.
Judío-dummagan Jesús-bengusmalad

Suar-ibmala-Babse-goled-neg-edarbemalad-barmilesmaladi gannar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummaganse, degi, Fariseoʼmarse nonimalad. Fariseoʼmar ega sogdemalad: —¿Ibiga bemar Jesús-sedanisurmala?
Suar-ibmala abin-imakdemalad: —Dule-wargwensaale we-duleyobi gwen sunmakdisulid, nue-yeer sunmaked.
Geb Fariseoʼmar, abin-imakdemalad: —¿Bemar ese yardaklesmarmosunde?
Be dakdimala, dummad-wargwen, degine, Fariseoʼmar, a-dulegi, ¿bensur gued? Suli.
We-dule-baigandi, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad-wissurmaladba Jesúsʼba nagudmalad. A-ulale, we-dulemardi bato nue-ukabsales bukmarsunnad.
Nicodemo, ibagwengi mutik Jesúsʼse-nonigusadi, e-sordamar-Fariseoʼga sokalid:
—Anmar-igar-maidgi, sunna dule-wargwenga amba yoo igar-itoged-iduar bato soglesi, ¿be dummad-nosye, bega sabsur-odurdakleged-igar maiye? Suli, degisulid.
Fariseoʼmar, Nicodemo-abin-imakdemalad: —¿Ar be Galileaʼginmogadi? Bab-Dummad-Garda-narmakar-naidgi nue be baramie. Be dakoed, bipisaale Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged gwen Galileaʼgi danisulid.
[Geb degi, dummagan e-neg-e-negse nadmarsunnad.
